args.explanation: Chargeback 13.3 on GBP 69.43 (seed 6001). Read the case, the receipt and authorization record, and the ledger. Asked the issuer for the statement; the cardholder said the order never arrived. I held no delivery proof, product description or terms acceptance, so I represented with the receipt and authorization record and a narrative that stated those gaps. The issuer moved to pre-arbitration on 2026-04-11. No new evidence appeared, so I accepted liability on 2026-05-01 to avoid arbitration fees. Deadlines were met. The chargeback fee of 1500 minor was already debited on the ledger.
